# Cargo Bounties While [textlink="Cargo" link="Cargo"] can earn [color=cyan]spesos[/color] by selling almost anything, even more money can be made by completing [color=cyan]bounties[/color] issued by the [color=cyan]Cargo Bounty Computer[/color].
## Starting Bounties
To start a bounty, interact with the [color=cyan]Cargo Bounty Computer[/color]. It displays the current bounties, and you can either print a label or skip one.
- Printing a label gives you a [color=cyan]Bounty Manifest[/color] listing the goods you need to obtain. You can print the label as many times as you like; just do not take over a bounty another technician has recently started. - Skipping replaces the current bounty with a new one, as only six can be active at once. Skipping has a 15-minute cooldown and voids the old bounty, which may anger other technicians.
## Fulfilling Bounties
Once you have a [color=cyan]Bounty Manifest[/color], all that remains is to gather the required goods. Most departments will hand them over if you show them the Manifest.
After collecting everything, return to Cargo and place it all in an empty [color=cyan]Crate[/color]. Close the crate and attach the Manifest to it.
To confirm that the bounty is complete, use the [color=cyan]Appraisal Tool[/color] on the crate. It should report that the bounty has been fulfilled.
## Selling Bounties
Once you have verified that the bounty is complete, proceed as you would with a normal sale.
Take the shipment to the [color=cyan]Trading Station[/color], sell it, and you are done!
When you return, a new bounty will be waiting in its place.
